verdict.rationale: Drive documents a dedicated search guide (guides/search-files) in which the files.list method returns all or some of a user's files and folders, so a documented search API exists. The evidence pack never shows querying filenames or full-text file content through that API. The only content-search mention is a community comment about OCR'd documents being searchable in the end-user product, not the API. missing for 10: documented filename and full-text content query operators in the search API, evidence of the query syntax beyond prefix matching, independent or hands-on corroboration of full-text API search.
